shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions fueled $80B crypto market cap loss amid US-Iran tensions.
$1B+ crypto liquidations occurred as escalating geopolitical fears triggered massive leveraged position liquidations.
Slower inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs contributed to cooling demand and added price pressure.
Bitmine acquired over $50M in ETH, signaling institutional conviction despite current price pressures.
BNB experienced a notable 12.56% price surge in 24 hours.
